state.seed_assertion: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.

sentences.1: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.2: Use continuity only when the circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.3: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.4: Voltage tests are performed on energized circuits, while continuity and resistance tests are performed only on de-energized circuits.
sentences.5: Continuity and resistance tests are done only on de-energized circuits.
sentences.6: This saves time and resources while keeping machines performing at their best.
sentences.7: Using continuity mode on a live circuit produces false positive 'good' results due to the supply voltage overwhelming the meter's test current.
sentences.8: Using continuity mode on a live circuit and getting a false 'good' result from the supply voltage.
sentences.9: Forcing PLC inputs and outputs should only be used carefully in test mode after ensuring safe conditions and must be immediately removed after testing.
sentences.10: A quality multimeter is the most essential tool for PLC troubleshooting to measure voltages, verify continuity, and check signal current.
sentences.11: Measure voltages at terminals, verify continuity, and check signal current.
sentences.12: A diagnostic report should contain documented evidence of reported fault, operating conditions, recent changes, tests performed, root cause, and preventive recommendations.
